name: kling-mcp
description: Kling AI (builder tools): me, generate_image, generate_video, get_job. Every tool maps to a document

platform_mcp_kling_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KLING_API_KEY
platform_mcp_kling_api_key.description: Kling AI API key (kling.ai/dev console > '+ Create a new API Key'; shown once), sent as Authorization: Bearer. The legacy AccessKey/SecretKey JWT scheme is not needed.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /account/costs?start_time&end_time (ms, the last 30 days): resource packages with remaining quantity; used as the credential check (no user endpoint).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: POST /v1/images/generations {model_name (kling-v3 default, kling-v2-1), prompt, negative_prompt (text-to-image only), image (reference URL/base64), aspect_ratio (16:9 default, 9:16, 1:1 …)} -> data {task_id, task_status}; poll with get_job.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: POST /text-to-video/{model} (default kling-3.0) {prompt, settings: {aspect_ratio 16:9|9:16|1:1, duration 3–15}} -> data {id, status}; poll with get_job. image_url is not sent (image-to-video is a separate endpoint).

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: GET /tasks?task_ids={id} ('Query Task (By task ID)'): status submitted|processing|succeeded|failed, message on failure, outputs[] with url/watermark_url per image/video/audio (all in raw.outputs). URLs expire after 30 days.
